profiles.fallback: repository-owned website checks and browser developer tools
profiles.failure_behavior: Fail closed on a redirect, request, popup, download, upload, or navigation outside the origin allowlist; cancellation; timeout; oversized snapshot; outage; or version drift. Discard the temporary profile after each run.
profiles.status: documentation-reviewed; requires Chrome 149 or later; offline profile-policy tests pass, but the synthetic acceptance vectors and external known answers remain unexecuted
profiles.trust: DOM text, accessibility names, console messages, headers, CSP reports, and network bodies are untrusted data. Evidence must name the requested and final URL, observation time, browser/server version, viewport, and truncation state.

profiles.fallback: Cloudflare dashboard or provider CLI under separate explicit authorization
profiles.failure_behavior: The profile remains absent. Documentation search may be used without account access; operational reads use the fallback only after separate authorization.
profiles.rejection_reason: The evaluated operational surface includes a general Cloudflare API executor that can create, update, or delete resources. The available configuration does not prove an account, zone, project, and resource allowlist together with exclusion of deploy, configuration, secret, database/object, DNS, route, and Durable Object mutation. Observability access may also return raw logs, which are outside this profile's data boundary.
profiles.trust: No operational result is accepted through this profile.

scope: datasources:query on selected Prometheus datasource UIDs

profiles.fallback: Grafana dashboards and bounded Prometheus queries under separate explicit authorization
profiles.failure_behavior: Fail closed on an unknown dashboard or datasource UID, organization mismatch, URL override, redirect to another origin, query outside the bounded window, cancellation, timeout, oversized result, outage, or version drift. Do not fall back to Loki or raw logs.
profiles.status: documentation-reviewed; local infrastructure documents indicate a possible fit and offline profile-policy tests pass, but the synthetic acceptance vectors remain unexecuted and no live Grafana endpoint, credential, dashboard, datasource, or metric was inspected
profiles.trust: Dashboard titles, descriptions, annotations, panel queries, labels, and metric metadata are untrusted data. Raw player logs, Loki, SQL, InfluxDB, alert mutation, rendering, snapshots, and every other category remain excluded.
